text:
Aisha (CS): quick thread — small accounts keep filing similar asks about exports and onboarding docs. can we triage for fast wins? :eyes:
Marco (Eng): saw 6 tickets this week labeled "export-ask". most are CSV + timezone weirdness.
Leah (PM): do we have a list of common phrasing? helps prioritize UI vs API work.
Aisha (CS): pasted 2 customer quotes below:
> "we just need CSV export of per-route usage, our finance team reconciles offline"
> "onboarding checklist is confusing — we missed the API key step and lost trial usage"
Ravi (DevEx): small fixes that look high-ROI: add a "Export CSV" button on billing route, and add a focused onboarding tooltip for API key. estimate ~1-2d each.
Priya (Support): can we batch these into one outreach? I'll validate which are renewal-risk vs nice-to-have.
Leah (PM): propose triage tiers: 
- quick-win (<=2d) -> UX button, tooltip, minor backend csv endpoint
- short project (1-2 sprints) -> CSV export with timezone normalization + scheduled exports
- backlog -> feature-rich exports (filters, columns)
Marco (Eng): I'm 👍 for quick-win. I can spike button + endpoint. need an owner for acceptance criteria + test cases.
Aisha (CS): I'll create acceptance criteria from the quotes and flag the top 3 affected accounts (they're all on small seats). will paste ticket links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4822
CS-Bot: New triage card created: CS-EXPORT-SWEEP-1719000001 (auto)
Leah (PM): thanks. @Marco please estimate in the ticket. @Ravi can you drop one-liner docs for the onboarding tooltip so Support can reference it?
Ravi (DevEx): will do. sample copy below for the tooltip:
"To get started: create an API key in Console > API keys. Keep it safe — you can rotate later."
Priya (Support): I'll ping the three customers to confirm impact and see if any would accept a polite workaround (download JSON + convert) in the short term.
Marco (Eng): quick question — do we need to run this by security for CSV content?
Leah (PM): low risk — only aggregated per-route usage, no PII. I'll confirm with security and update ticket.
Aisha (CS): ok owners: Marco (eng) - implement button + endpoint; Ravi (devex) - tooltip + docs; Priya (support) - customer validation; Leah (pm) - security ok + prioritize. Can someone add labels: `triage:quick-win`, `area:billing`, `impact:small-accounts`?
Marco (Eng): added labels and left a short PR plan in the ticket. planning to pair with Ravi for QA.
Leah (PM): target: ship quick-wins in next sprint's first week. if security sign-off delays, fallback is a documented manual export process for CS.
Aisha (CS): perfect. tagging this thread for weekly sync notes. :thumbsup:
Priya (Support): I will update the customer-facing KB once this ships.
CS-Bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 7 days (1719005760)
Leah (PM): thanks everyone — closing the loop here. if anything blocks, reply and I'll escalate.
